result:
Round 41 (TM-B43, docs only) passes on all five checks (R41-1 to R41-5), and I ran the real app check (realVerified=true). I found no bugs. I re-ran every check myself, and I changed nothing in the repository.

- **R41-1, ownership:** only the 3 owned docs files changed. `src`, `tests`, `.claude`, `.github`, the package files and `style-guide.md` are identical to `e386cca`. The diff matches B's prototype line for line (57 changed lines on each side), and each of the 3 files is byte-identical to B's copy. In `component-specs.md`, the changes are all inside the `### SchemaEditor` section. I repeated these checks at the end of my phase and the results were the same, so nothing changed while I worked.
- **R41-2, docs against code:** every class string and attribute in the new spec appears word for word in `SchemaEditor.tsx`. The line references are right: `:157` is Back, `:202` is Trash2, `:210` is X and `:230` is the chip. `variantStyles` in `button.tsx` carries `enabled:not-aria-disabled:hover:` on all 5 variants. Back is the only button in the spec with plain `hover:`, and it sits outside the fieldset.
- **R41-3, real app:** I launched the built app under `xvfb-run` with Playwright, opened a folder with a fixture WAV, selected it and opened Customize Fields. Then I hid Category (UCS) so its chip appeared, and added a custom field `C41Client`. The live `className` of each element (header, Back, title, content, fieldset, footer, row, both arrows, X, chip, Trash2) matches the spec exactly, with no missing or extra classes. Done shows `aria-disabled="false"` and `aria-busy="false"`. There were no page or console errors. Screenshot: `c-round-41/r41-schema-editor.png`.
- **R41-4, counts and the Georgian docs:**
  - **Counts:** the bug file has 22 entries and 13 marked fixed, line 3 lists `(22)`, and the README says 22/13/9. The 9 open entries are unchanged from `e386cca`.
  - **D-46 and entry (22):** the D-46 bullet comes right after D-45 and ends with `ჩანაწერი (22).` Entry (22) has the same 10 fields in the same order as entry (21).
  - **References:** the Bootstrap and Tailwind pages still say what entry (22) claims.
  - **Facts:** the rgb values, `24e9723`, `ea4a1cb` and B-R39-01 match the round-39 and round-40 evidence.
- **R41-5, gate:** from a clean state, the full `verifyCommand` exits 0. Biome reports 0 errors and the same 8 warnings as round 35, and the type check passes. Results: renderer 310/310, main 93/93, E2E 7/7, and 7/7 again with `--retries=0`.

One small wording note, not a bug: entry (22)'s list of buttons that are never disabled is incomplete (for example, the tag remove button in TagsInput). The claim is still true, and B could mark the list with `მაგ.` (e.g.). A's other note, the word "cue" in D-46, is intended wording and needs no change.

Windows packaging is listed as blocked because it is not available in the cloud; it is not part of this round.

PASS closes TM-B43 and findings C-R40-01, A-R40-01, A-R40-02, RR-R40-01 and A-R40-04(a). A-R40-04(b) stays open with B-R39-02.

Files are in `/home/runner/czaba-project/tmp/tag-manager-loop/`:
- `c-round-41.md`
- `c-round-41.json`
- `c-round-41/` (logs, probe script, DOM dump, screenshots)
